topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can hardly believe what I'm hearing. The professor's words echo in a way that makes the room feel hollow. How did it come to this? I spent countless nights on that paper, pouring over every detail, every source cited. Now, it’s all being questioned. I tried to explain, to articulate how each sentence was a mix of my thoughts and the knowledge I gathered, but my voice wavers, and the words don’t come out as confidently as I hoped. I need to prove my integrity, to show that I didn’t just take someone else’s work and call it my own. But right now, it feels like no one’s listening, and I’m running out of ways to make them understand.
